en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
Let's relax in the sun
Let's dance!
What a great view...

Sunbathing is niiiice.
It's soooo peaceful...

I start thinking about how stupid it is to
be the leader of an evil organization.
Eureka!

When I get outta here, I'll form a charity
organization for the good of others!
<CLT=cltMIND>...That *has* to be a lie.

Wow Shuichi, you suggested something hip.
I thought you were more of an introvert.

Like I imagine you curled up at the corner
of your room licking dust or something...
<CLT=cltMIND>That sounds more like a monster...

Yup, it reminds me of my hometown!
I was born in a place similar to here.

The first time I saw this place, I was like...
Whoa, what a coinkydink!

Bleeeh, I can't believe I made such a horrible
lie... I'm so bored.

God, it's your fault for bringing me to
a place like this, Shuichi.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
<CLT=cltMIND>Huh?
<CLT=cltMIND>That voice just now. Is that...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that Kokichi's inner thoughts...?
